why_supersedes: marker co-variance was the wrong observable; interpretive yield is reorganization, not lexis
measure: coverage + sharpness + development of a frozen six-slot lens, against four frozen rival lenses, at four unit levels
nt_role: included at all four levels; the most informative case, having documented multi-author structure with contested attributions — the condition the Platonic corpus is tested for
derived_predictions: Plato at L1 fills all six slots with six different dialogues
NT fills poorly at L1, better at L2, best at L3
if Plato behaves like the NT the Platonic corpus is organized above the level of its dialogues
if Plato fills at L1 where the NT fills only at L3 they are structurally different objects and the extended-corpus thesis loses its closest analogue
kill_conditions: any rival within 1 slot of the transmission lens on Plato = no differential yield
R4 random control above 3/6 on any corpus = assignment protocol too permissive, entire run VOID
no slot redefinition after seeing an assignment
anti_circularity: assignments from received characterization only; passages discovered in this investigation (Letter XIII symbolon, Phaedo 59b, M34) are development predictions and score only in that column
principal_weakness: the assigner is not blind; a genuinely blind protocol would need an assigner ignorant of which lens is under test, unavailable here
